definition: The assembly rules this style sets between its parts, relations between slots rather than values of one, each shown in its state: tested by the checker on a plan, left to your judgment, or not yet given a test.
basis: Editorial. docs/inheritance.md: "Constraints live on the style node, not in the kit, because they are relations between slots rather than values of one." and "Hard constraints are what stop a generator from producing incoherent houses." docs/constraints.md: a judgment constraint "is listed for hand review rather than silently passed or given an invented threshold."

surface.what: The assembly rules this style sets between its parts.
read: Each rule keeps its statement in words and shows its severity: hard, soft or advisory.
An executable rule carries a test the checker runs on a plan.
A rule its sources state only in words is left to your judgment, never passed in silence.
